metadata.description:
The IDS Tower is the undisputed heavyweight champion of the Minneapolis skyline. Designed by Philip Johnson, its shimmering glass and precise geometry make it a masterpiece of modernism. It’s not just a building—it’s a vertical ecosystem, complete with the Crystal Court at its base. This Architecture Aficionado POAP rewards your ascent to the city’s architectural apex in the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Architecture Aficionado 
GPS: 44.97615, -93.27239 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.97615,-93.27239
